approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 71 Chapter 382
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7463-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to  amend  the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to the
        suspension of a license to drive a motor vehicle or motorcycle"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This bill, as originally written, would eliminate the power to suspend
a driver's license where a person fails to answer a summons, appear at a
hearing, or pay a fine associated with the issuance of a traffic ticket.
In addition, the bill would provide the option for  a  person  to  enter
into  an  installment  payment plan for the incremental payment of fines
and surcharges imposed as a consequence of a traffic violation. Finally,
the bill would terminate all existing driver's license  suspensions  for
failure to answer, appear, or pay a fine.
 
  I fully support the majority of the provisions of this bill. New York-
ers  require  driver's  licenses  to live, work, and vest care for their
families.  The use of license suspensions to compel the payment of fines
has proven to be inefficient, and disproportionately impacts  low-income
communities and communities of color. Its elimination, combined with the
option  of  entering  into  an installment payment plan, will allow safe
drivers to remain on the roads while providing  a  reasonable  means  of
satisfying their debt to the State. However, I cannot lend my support to
the elimination of suspensions for failure to answer a summons or appear
at a hearing. The vehicle and traffic laws of this state are designed to
keep all users of the roadways safe. Answering and appearing on summons-
es is an essential part of the State's public safety obligation to iden-
tify  bad  drivers. Allowing drivers to simply ignore their tickets will
inevitably allow for scofflaws to remain on the  roads,  and  present  a
health  and  safety  hazard  to  the  traveling  public. As such, I have
reached a chapter amendment agreement with  the  legislature  to  remove
this provision, and allow the remaining provisions to take effect.
 
  This bill is approved.                      (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
 
                                ______

summary: Limits the grounds for the suspension of a driver's license; provides for additional notification when a person is required to make an appearance; requires income based payment plans to be available for fines, fees and mandatory surcharges incurred as a result of a violation of the vehicle and traffic law and makes conforming changes.
